channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Compare how India's media, left, centre and right, covers each story, side by side.

item.title: Israeli President Pardons Soldier Elor Azaria, Clears Record
item.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has pardoned Elor Azaria, a former Israeli soldier, and cleared his criminal record. The pardon follows a lengthy legal battle. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Madras High Court: Caste Not Determined by Appearance or English
item.description: The Madras High Court has ruled that caste cannot be determined by a person's appearance, complexion, height, or hair. The court overturned an order that had cancelled a Scheduled Caste (SC) certificate. The case involved an individual… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Mumbai Ganesh Pandal Electrocution Kills Two, Injures Four
item.description: During Ganesh idol immersion in Jogeshwari, a current spread in the immersion tank, resulting in the death of a youth. In the Lalbaug area, near a Ganesh pandal, a child and a woman died due to electrocution, and four others were injured… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman Argues with TTE, Tears Clothes

item.title: US military kills four in strike on Caribbean drug boat
item.description: The U.S. military reported that it killed four individuals during a strike on a boat suspected of drug smuggling in the Caribbean. The Pentagon confirmed the incident. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Police Clash with Far-Right Protesters in The Hague
item.description: Police clashed with hundreds of far-right protesters in The Hague during an anti-immigration rally. The event involved video footage of the confrontations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: An Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) of Punjab Police, Harjit Singh, was shot dead while on duty at the Bhagtawala Grain Market in Amritsar. Director General of Police (DGP) Gaurav Yadav visited the crime scene following the incident. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee challenges Election Commission's symbol freeze in Supreme Court

item.title: Mountain Lion Roams San Francisco Streets, Sea Lion Found Beheaded
item.description: A mountain lion was observed roaming through San Francisco neighborhoods. Separately, a beheaded sea lion was discovered along the city's shore, prompting an investigation. The circumstances surrounding both incidents are under… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: AI's national security risks highlighted in Beijing
item.description: China's spy agency has warned that the hacking capabilities of Artificial Intelligence (AI) are leading Beijing to view national security threats in a new light. The focus is on AI's potential to pose risks to national security. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Explosions were heard in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with smoke seen near the capital's main airport. The Houthi group claimed responsibility for a missile strike on the city, marking a target on Riyadh for the first time since an escalation… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 16 · Right 4.

item.title: Hong Kong Police Arrest Three in Drug Bust
item.description: Hong Kong police arrested three individuals in Fanling and seized HK$23 million worth of "Ice," a form of methamphetamine. The bust was part of an operation that also saw customs officials at the airport seize 13kg of suspected ketamine… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.description: North Korea launched two ballistic missiles towards Japan on Sunday, according to South Korean and Japanese authorities. The missiles landed outside Japan's exclusive economic zone. The launches occurred within a three-hour period. North… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 10 · Right 4.

item.title: Imran Khan's Sister Arrested in Lahore
item.description: Aleema Khan, sister of former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan, was arrested at her Lahore residence on Sunday. The arrest occurred ahead of a planned protest by the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) for Imran Khan's release. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.description: Russia launched drone and missile attacks targeting Ukrainian cities including Kyiv and Kharkiv. The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) reported being informed of a drone strike on the cooling tower of the Kursk nuclear power plant… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 17 · Right 2.

item.title: Shark drumlines removed after Sorrento attack
item.description: Fisheries have withdrawn drumlines that were deployed in an attempt to catch a shark involved in an attack at Sorrento. The drumlines were set following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bangkok Metro Services Halted Due to Elevated Track Fire
item.description: Bangkok's metro services were suspended after a fire broke out on an elevated track. All services on the Bangkok Metro (MRT) were halted due to the incident. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Madeleine McCann suspect Christian Brueckner reportedly planning book
item.description: Christian Brueckner, the prime suspect in the disappearance of Madeleine McCann, is reportedly planning to write a tell-all book. The book is expected to cause further distress to McCann's parents. Brueckner has also claimed he was 150… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Six French IS suspects on trial in Iraq for terrorism
item.description: Six French nationals suspected of belonging to the Islamic State (IS) group have gone on trial in Iraq. The suspects face charges of terrorism. If convicted, they could face the death penalty. The trial is taking place in an Iraqi court. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Man Found Dead in Luxury Car in Bengaluru
item.description: A 46-year-old man, identified as Salim Akbar from Kodagu, was found dead inside a luxury car parked in Bengaluru's Koramangala area on Sunday morning. Security camera footage indicated the car had been parked near a restaurant around 2:30… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Delhi High Court is set to welcome seven new judges who will be sworn in on Monday at 10 am on the high court premises. The new appointments will increase the court's total strength to 50 judges. The new judges include Nivedita Anil… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Tata Trusts Appoints Abhishek Manu Singhvi Amidst Dispute
item.description: Tata Trusts has appointed senior Supreme Court lawyer Abhishek Manu Singhvi to represent its interests in an ongoing dispute. The dispute appears to be heading towards court, with Singhvi stating that ending shareholder rights poses a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Pakistan Operation: Militants, Hostages, and Security Forces Involved
item.description: In Pakistan's southwest, security forces killed five militants and freed 23 hostages. Separately, in a clash in northwest Pakistan, eight Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) militants and six security personnel were killed. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Akal Takht Expels SAD Leader Amarjit Singh Chawla
item.description: The Akal Takht has expelled Akali Dal (SAD) leader Amarjit Singh Chawla from the 'Khalsa Panth'. Granthi Malkit Singh was also expelled. The expulsion is reportedly over a rape accusation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Akhilesh Yadav alleges inaction over 151 Ambedkar statue vandalisms in UP
item.description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has alleged that 151 statues of B.R. Ambedkar have been vandalized in Uttar Pradesh under the current BJP rule. Yadav stated that only 14 arrests have been made in connection with these incidents. He… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Dog Attacks Injure Multiple Children in Separate Incidents
item.description: In Faridabad, Haryana, a pitbull dog attacked a 7th-grade student, biting the child in 16 places on their body, including limbs, while the owner reportedly watched. In a separate incident in Palari, a stray dog attacked more than a dozen… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala Anti-Drug Drive Leads to Over 12,000 Arrests
item.description: As part of 'Operation Toofan', Kerala Police have arrested 12,111 individuals in an anti-drug campaign. The Railway Police and the Railway Protection Force (RPF) are intensifying checks to prevent drug smuggling into the state. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: New CAT Court Complex Inaugurated in Jammu by Union Minister
item.description: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated a new court complex for the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) in Jammu. He stated that the Jammu bench of the CAT has disposed of the highest number of service cases in the country. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Forest Guard and Others Targeted in Online Scams Totaling Over ₹112 Crore
item.description: Two separate online scams have been reported, targeting individuals through fraudulent schemes. In one incident, a forest guard in Khargone lost ₹10.95 lakh to a fake trading app promoted via a WhatsApp group. Khargone police arrested… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: GST Intelligence busts Rs 30 Crore Tax Evasion at Tobacco Factory
item.description: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) Intelligence department conducted a raid on a tobacco and gutkha manufacturing factory in Bhopal. The operation uncovered tax evasion amounting to at least ₹30 crore. During the raid, machinery, raw… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: BJP Leader's Brother Arrested in Balaghat Rice Scam
item.description: Rajkumar Kawre, brother of the BJP district president and former minister, has been arrested in Bhopal in connection with the Balaghat rice scam. This is the 20th arrest in the case, which involves the diversion of government rice to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Karnataka FDA Busts Fake Medicine Racket, Seizes ₹5 Crore Stock
item.description: Karnataka's Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has busted a counterfeit medicine racket in Bengaluru, leading to the cancellation of 16 drug licenses and suspension of eight. The operation involved raiding an illegal facility in Bidadi… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Bus Driver Attacked, Bus Stolen in Telford, England
item.description: A bus driver was attacked and his bus stolen in Telford, England. The assailant, described as a youth, reportedly assaulted the Sikh bus driver and fled with the vehicle. The stolen bus was then driven in the wrong direction, crashing into… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Four Dead in Telangana Car Crash After Ganesh Immersion
item.description: Four people died when their car crashed in Telangana while returning from Ganesh idol immersion. The incident occurred as the occupants were traveling back after participating in the Ganesh Visarjan festivities. The car, identified as an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Eight Devotees Die After Car Swept Away in Flooded Drain in MP
item.description: Eight devotees returning from a visit to the Maa Baglamukhi temple in Nalkheda, Agar Malwa district, Madhya Pradesh, died when their car was swept away in a swollen monsoon drain. The deceased included three children, two women, and three… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Paramount Nears Settlement in Warner Bros. Merger Lawsuit
item.description: Paramount Global is reportedly in advanced settlement talks with several U.S. states over its proposed merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Sources suggest a settlement could be reached as soon as this weekend. Paramount has discussed… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: The Australian government is considering a ban on the use of smart glasses in government workplaces. This potential policy aims to address security concerns associated with the technology. The move comes as smart glasses are being explored… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Dozens Die in Nigeria from Suspected Poisoned Alcohol and Custodial Deaths
item.description: In Nigeria, nearly 50 people have died after consuming suspected methanol-laced local alcohol. Separately, at least 37 suspected illegal miners have died while in the custody of a paramilitary agency in central Nigeria. The custodial… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 8 · Right 2.

item.title: Dog Appears to Greet Intruder, Pestering Them to Play
item.description: Video footage from San Diego shows a golden retriever appearing to greet a home intruder, instead of barking. The dog reportedly brought a toy to the intruder and seemed to pester them to play during the break-in. The incident has led to… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Holdout Juror Speaks on Mistrial in Mother's Murder Case
